remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: I saw this at Miss O'Keeffe's apartment in April 1946, but did not measure it. O'Keeffe says about 20 x 24. Infor. from O'Keeffe, May 3, 1946: Sold to Newark Museum." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: 1943" [not verified]. See cat. nos. 1857, 1901. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Purchase 1946 John J. O'Neil Bequest Fund
description: The soft petals of a white flower fill the frame. The flower has a green center with yellow stamens. Green leaves and a brownish-red background frame the bloom.
